before.fixture: Fixed native tiered builds plus duplicate weapon, three Health Potions and an off-class Healing Tome. One unenchanted attribute ring at T1/T4/T7 matched to the three gear variants; none baseline leaves that cell empty. Same gear positions across attributes; deterministic placement maximizes eligible adjacent items, then native items, without inspecting battle outcomes. Full base HP and five mana before ring bonuses; Normal difficulty.
before.limitations: Results compare these builds and placements, not every build, starting condition, dungeon depth or ring combination. Clear counts are not player win probabilities. Amounts differ by archetype and mana cost affects usefulness. No ring stacking is simulated.
